title: Tax Manager – Reporting & Technology
description: Based in Milwaukee, WI, this role shapes how Molson Coors uses technology to simplify complex tax processes, strengthen controls, and unlock insights across its global tax function. It partners with Tax, Finance, and IT to transform global tax processes through automation, analytics, AI, and emerging technologies, reducing manual processes, enhancing data quality, and enabling higher-value strategic activities. The role ensures reliable operation, support, and continuous improvement of existing tax technology solutions. It includes direct people leadership responsibility and significant influence over global tax processes, systems, data, controls, and technology-enabled transformation priorities. Reports to the Sr. Director Global Tax Reporting.
workArrangement: Flexible work programs supporting work life balance, including a hybrid work model of 4 days in the office.
salary: $109,100.00 - $143,200.00 (posting salary range) + 15% target short term incentive + $23,000 on average spent on benefits per employee. The posting salary range is what Molson Coors, in good faith, believes it would pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual pay is based on non-discriminatory factors including required work location, previous work experience, skill set, and internal equity.
experience: 6+ years of experience in corporate tax, tax technology, or tax process improvements within a multinational corporation or public accounting firm.
responsibilities: Own and lead the global tax technology strategy, roadmap, and operating model, ensuring tax technology capabilities effectively support tax compliance, reporting, planning, controls, workflow, analytics, and business decision-making needs.

Drive enterprise-level tax transformation initiatives and innovation through automation, analytics, AI, and emerging technologies, including hands-on use of AI-enabled tools such as Claude and Copilot, and data platforms to build and maintain dashboards and self-service reporting, improving efficiency, scalability, and decision-making across the tax function.

Set priorities, build business cases, define success measures, and align resources for tax technology initiatives, ensuring investments deliver measurable outcomes such as efficiency gains, risk reduction, faster cycle times, improved controls, and enhanced decision-making.

Partner with senior stakeholders across Tax, Finance, IT, Enterprise Data, Internal Controls, and external vendors to manage dependencies, influence and align priorities, resolve issues, and deliver sustainable technology solutions across the global tax function.
Lead adoption and change management by raising technology capabilities across the Tax team through training, championing new ways of working, and driving adoption of technology solutions.
Monitor emerging technologies and industry-leading practices and identify opportunities to further simplify tax processes, improve data quality, and enhance the effectiveness of the Tax organization.

Ensure a strong tax technology control environment by establishing and maintaining disciplined data, process, and access governance, mitigating risk while supporting efficient and reliable tax operations.
Ensure reliable operation, support, and continuous improvement of existing tax technology solutions.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in corporate tax, tax technology, or tax process improvements within a multinational corporation or public accounting firm.
Demonstrated experience with tax technology platforms such as Corptax, ONESOURCE, or similar tax compliance and provision solutions.
Strong understanding of multinational tax compliance and tax reporting processes.
Demonstrated experience leading technology, automation, or process improvement initiatives.
Experience with analytics and productivity applications such as Power BI, Power Query, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or comparable tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions and influence stakeholders across functions.
Experience developing and coaching team members while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Preferred: In-depth knowledge of tax issues affecting global multinational businesses.
Preferred: In-depth, administrator level knowledge of Corptax or ONESOURCE.
Preferred: Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP.
benefits: Total Rewards program including a competitive base salary, incentive plans, parental leave, health, dental, vision, retirement plan options with above market employer match, generous paid time off, wellness programs and incentives, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
Paid time off includes holidays, vacation days, and sick days.
On site Pub, access to brand clothing and swag, top events, and free beer and beverages.
Community involvement through charitable donations and activities such as building parks.
Business Resource Groups that can provide volunteer opportunities, leadership experience, and networking throughout the organization.
Career growth and development through First Choice Learning opportunities.
Work within a fast paced and innovative company with colleagues and partners from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
equalOpportunity: Molson Coors is an equal opportunity employer and invites applications from candidates of all backgrounds, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic.
